findings.summary: The interface ignores the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is visually identical to the light view, and page-probe.json reports no color-scheme or prefers-color-scheme CSS; body remains rgb(255,255,255).
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use preference-aware surface/text colours, such as light-dark(), with tested contrast in both schemes.

findings.summary: Navigation swaps documents abruptly with no transition affordance.
findings.evidence: The CSS/DOM probe found no view-transition declarations on the listing, while the site has repeated listing-to-detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a progressive cross-document View Transition for listing-to-detail navigation and disable non-essential motion under reduced motion.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide no position or progress feedback.
findings.evidence: The homepage is 2,432 CSS pixels tall at the probe viewport, but inspection found no sticky/progress chrome or scroll-state styling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained scrollability cue or progress affordance appropriate to long listings, without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Cards adapt only through a page-wide breakpoint, not their available container.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container/container-type use; card widths switch globally at max-width:460px.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the reusable listing container a query context and adapt card layout with container queries while retaining a simple fallback.

findings.summary: Several controls and adjacent links do not provide sufficient touch target area or spacing.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse target-size failed with seven groups, including a 144x19 language selector and overlapping/adjacent card and footer links.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive target height/spacing to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary controls, and remove overlapping card hit areas.

findings.summary: The empty search state does not say that no results were found or offer a clear recovery action.
findings.evidence: The unlikely-query screenshot shows only the query heading followed by “Latest searches”; there is no explicit zero-result message, clear-search control, or suggestions labeled as alternatives.
findings.suggestedFix: Render an explicit no-results state with the query, a clear/reset action, and clearly labeled alternative suggestions.

findings.summary: Representative pages have no main landmark.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed landmark-one-main and page/detail probes found zero main or role=main elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the unique page content in <main>, keep navigation in <nav>, and preserve the existing logical heading sequence.

findings.summary: The representative 12-minute video has no captions or subtitle track.
findings.evidence: detail-probe.json found one video with native controls but an empty tracks array; video-readiness confirms the media is available and 723.92 seconds long.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide accurate WebVTT captions with <track kind="captions" srclang="…"> and expose a transcript or equivalent where possible.

findings.summary: Video detail pages omit a meta description.
findings.evidence: The representative detail probe returned a descriptive title and canonical URL but no meta description.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate a unique, accurate meta description for each video detail page from visible editorial metadata.

findings.summary: Pages lack social preview metadata even though detail pages represent shareable video entities.
findings.evidence: The homepage and detail probes found zero Open Graph tags. The detail has Article JSON-LD, but no og:title, og:description, og:image, or video preview metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add Open Graph/Twitter preview tags that match visible content, and use an appropriate VideoObject schema where the media metadata supports it.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent.
findings.evidence: headers.json reports missing Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security and X-Content-Type-Options on the main document.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive tested CSP, HSTS after confirming HTTPS coverage, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

findings.summary: Analytics cookies are set with insecure attributes.
findings.evidence: cookies.json reports _ga and _ga_Q6V23V0TV0 without Secure, with SameSite=None, and 400-day expiry.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure and an appropriate SameSite policy, shorten retention, and avoid setting analytics cookies until the applicable consent/legal basis exists.

findings.summary: Long-lived analytics tracking starts on page load without an evident consent choice.
findings.evidence: The HAR and tracker probe record Google Tag Manager/Analytics immediately; two 400-day analytics cookies are set and the first viewport has no consent/control UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise analytics, gate non-essential tracking behind a clear consent choice where required, shorten retention, and provide an accessible preference/revocation control.

findings.summary: Clickjacking, referrer and permission defenses are not configured.
findings.evidence: headers.json reports no frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP frame-ancestors, a suitable Referrer-Policy and a deny-by-default Permissions-Policy; add HSTS after validation.

findings.summary: The 404 response offers unrelated content without explaining recovery.
findings.evidence: The route correctly returns HTTP 404, but its screenshot shows only “404” and a grid of videos, with no explanation, search prompt, or explicit route back to useful content.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the correct status and add a concise not-found message plus prominent home/search recovery actions.

findings.summary: The multilingual interface is not prepared for bidirectional or translated layout.
findings.evidence: The page advertises English/Indian sections and a translation selector, but CSS inspection found no logical properties and the document has no dir value.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction appropriately and replace physical left/right spacing and positioning with logical inline/block properties, then test an RTL locale.

findings.summary: The search field does not identify its autofill/input purpose.
findings.evidence: The form probe found the required search input with an empty autocomplete value and no associated visible label.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a visible search label (it may be visually hidden) and autocomplete="off" or an intentional search-oriented policy; keep its accessible name explicit.

findings.summary: Analytics JavaScript dominates an otherwise lightweight page load.
findings.evidence: The HAR totals 421,422 transferred bytes; Google Tag Manager alone transfers 156,839 bytes, about 37%, and Cloudflare analytics adds 11,577 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary tags, defer analytics until consent/idle, and prefer a lighter first-party or server-side measurement approach where measurement is necessary.
